front: Tuesday's six-game slate was mostly blowouts: New York beat Milwaukee by 32, Phoenix beat the Clippers by 23, Boston beat Philadelphia by 22 and Portland beat Oklahoma City by 20, so Brunson, Booker, Garland, Bridges and White all sat early. Orlando and Sacramento carried the night (Wagner 33 points, Black 26 with 4 steals, LaVine 31 on 6-9 from three), while Philadelphia's big names all came in under (Embiid 2-9) and Sabonis scored 0 in 24 minutes. Herro, Markkanen and Hart sat, but none was an early pick, so every team stays graded. Your 80 teams put 2 in the top 1% (best finish top 0.1%, 2.5 times the field's rate) and 11 in the top 10%, and 14 cashed, returning $690 on $400 in entries. The morning board did the work: it picked the right player on 68% of its disagreements with our projection (56% on the season) and 64% against ADP, while the afternoon board was 48% against ETR. The blowout pattern held: fades on players in blowouts (Garland, Green, Lopez) were right again, now 15 right and 3 wrong on the season, against 2 right and 16 wrong for raises. Nothing to decide today.

moves.5: One hedge the tags miss: Markkanen was untagged at your afternoon lock but Questionable at tip, and Collier, held for him, scored 31.5 on 24 minutes with him out.

card: The 1/2-turn reaches paid last night (3 of 4 teams in the top 10%), but that's one night against a season that shows an early sign reaching there hurts.
